title: Lease Term Agreement Corrected Offer Rent — Calculation Worksheet for Like-Program Lines
content:
The corrected offer rent of a like-program renewal offer line on a Lease Term Agreement — the line for the expiring term's own term program — is the capped 12-month-equivalent rent adjusted by the term program's rent adjustment, rounded half up to the cent.

## Definitions

- **Company cap.** The expiring term program's renewal increase cap, as published in the renewal offer calendar.
- **Statutory increase cap.** The cap of the community's state where one exists: 8.8 percent in California and 9.68 percent in Washington. The community's state is the state recorded on the Apartment Home Lease.
- **Effective cap.** The company cap, limited to the statutory increase cap of the community's state where one exists — the lower of the two. In a state with no statutory increase cap, the effective cap is the company cap.
- **Capped 12-month-equivalent rent.** The in-place contracted rent of the expiring term raised by the effective cap: the contracted rent multiplied by one plus the effective cap.
- **Rent adjustment of the term program.** A program with a premium adds the larger of its rent adjustment percentage of the capped 12-month-equivalent rent and its minimum monthly premium; a program with a discount subtracts its rent adjustment percentage of that rent; a program with no adjustment adds nothing.

## Rounding

No intermediate figure is rounded; only the corrected offer rent is rounded, half up to the cent. Half up means that an amount reaching half a cent, or falling short of half a cent by no more than 0.0001 cents, is rounded up to the next cent, and any other amount is rounded down.

## Worked lines (hypothetical in-place rent of 2,000.00 dollars)

| Program and state | Company cap | Effective cap | Capped 12-month-equivalent rent | Program adjustment | Corrected offer rent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months), Colorado | 8 percent | 8 percent | 2,160.00 | none | 2,160.00 |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months), California | 9 percent | 8.8 percent | 2,176.00 | premium 8 percent: 174.08, larger than 75.00 | 2,350.08 |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months), Washington | 7 percent | 7 percent | 2,140.00 | discount 1 percent: 21.40 subtracted | 2,118.60 |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months), Texas | 6 percent | 6 percent | 2,120.00 | discount 2 percent: 42.40 subtracted | 2,077.60 |

In the California line the company cap of 9 percent is above the statutory cap of 8.8 percent, so 8.8 percent governs; in Washington the company cap of 7 percent is below 9.68 percent and governs.
